copy.headline: Dallas weather: Cold front drops temperatures into the 30s ahead of chilly Thanksgiving holiday
copy.caption: A strong cold front sweeps across North Texas on Sunday, dropping temperatures into the 30s with wind chills in the 20s and bringing the season's first freeze ahead of Thanksgiving.
